citizens, the name of the association and the printed name and signature of at least one of its •principal officers.

for a safe, strong San Carlos
San Carlos is known as the City of Good Living because generations of residents have invested
in our safe streets, clean parks, reliable local services, and unmatched quality of life. But those
basics do not maintain themselves and San Carlos faces sharp increases in costs to fund public
safety, maintain streets and parks, and provide quality services to residents.
This half cent sales tax provides locally controlled funding to fix potholes, repair aging streets
and sidewalks, improve storm drains, maintain parks and community facilities, support
emergency response, and keep San Carlos neighborhoods safe and well cared for.
Families and local businesses are already facing higher costs, and voters will be asked to
consider several measures on November's ballot. That is exactly why Measure deserves
careful consideration. It provides local money for local needs. The funds generated will stay in
San Carlos, cannot be taken by the State or County, and are subject to independent audits and
Putting off basic maintenance does not save money. Cracked sidewalks, failing sewers, aging
park amenities and infrastructure continue to require our attention. This Measure will ensure San
Carlos address everyday problems before they become bigger and even more costly.
Endorsed by local leaders, Labor, Fire, San Carlos business owners, and public safety
is not about expanding government. It's about investing in the quality
of life we enjoy, the streets we drive, the sidewalks we travel with our kids, the parks where
families gather, and the emergency services we count on when minutes matter.
Join us in supporting this sensible, locally-controlled solution to maintaining a safe, strong San
Carlos for enerations to come. www.YesforSanCarlos.com.
